# Subagent (Google)

Google says subagent in the industry's sense of a [subagent][industry.subagent]: specialists with "their own isolated context loop", which cannot call other subagents ([Gemini CLI subagents][g7]).

## Examples

- Gemini CLI's subagents, such as codebase_investigator, cli_help, generalist and browser_agent ([Gemini CLI subagents][g7]).
- Antigravity's subagents, each in its own Git worktree ([Antigravity overview][g2]).
